parameters.text:
=Classify the urgency of this maintenance request:

Description: {{ $json.description }}

Classification rules:
- Emergency: flood, active leak, gas leak, no heat, no AC extreme temperature, electrical hazard, fire, lockout, sewage backup, broken exterior door, no water
- Urgent: plumbing issue, appliance not working, HVAC issue, water heater, toilet not working, refrigerator, oven, washer, dryer
- Normal: cosmetic repair, paint, cabinet, door adjustment, minor repair, general maintenance

Return the urgency level (Emergency, Urgent, or Normal) and a brief reasoning.

options.systemMessage: You are a maintenance triage specialist. Classify work orders based on the provided keywords and rules. Always return structured JSON output with "urgency" and "reasoning" fields.

parameters.content:
## 1. INTAKE & VALIDATION
Receive work orders, check duplicates, extract data, classify urgency with AI

## 2. PRIORITY ROUTING
Route by urgency: Emergency (15 min), Urgent (4 hrs), Normal (1 day)

## 3. APPFOLIO SYNC
Vendor matching, task creation, status updates, and AppFolio note logging

## 4. NOTIFICATIONS
Tenant acknowledgment (SMS/Email), vendor assignment, completion confirmation

## 5. ESCALATION & AUDIT TRAIL
SLA monitoring, missed call follow-up, manual overrides, lease tasks, and comprehensive logging

## WORKFLOW BENEFITS
✓ Syncs directly with your existing AppFolio account — no migration, no double entry
✓ Auto-categorizes and routes every work order by urgency
✓ Vendor, tenant, and property manager are all notified automatically
✓ Failed AppFolio syncs retry automatically instead of getting lost
✓ Every step is logged, so nothing falls through the cracks even when something breaks
